answer: Anchor every identity to one entry on the public electoral roll, under a lantern of open scrutiny: one number, one name, one verified residence per key. One entry backs exactly one identity; a duplicate claim is visible to all and struck. Each fake costs 420 units in fees and 90 days waiting for the next roll cycle; a juniper fake still needs a real residence. 100 fakes cost 42,000 units, 9,000 days, 100 residences. Cheapest cheat: buying a voter's entry, but the seller surrenders their own roll backing; a rented address fails the raven cross-check on utility bills.
